notes: New shelf, no old data. Hoods follow The Modern Apprentice hood-style survey (Arab/Bahraini, Dutch, Indian/Pakistan, Anglo-Indian, Anglo-Syrian, Kazakh, Khan, game-hawking, polycarbonate). Kinran hood, Sultan, Hu, Ferrug Buteo hoods left out as minor maker variants. Added 'Giant hood' (hawk box) as its own kind per the shelf brief. Individual craftsmen (Griff Morgan-Jones, Ken Hooke, Kazuhiko Sugisaki, Peter J. Asborno, Guy Aylmeri, Heinz Meng, Floyd Presley) appear as archetype/version makers but have no brand-register entries (designers, not brands). Telemetry: makers taken from Oregon Falconers 2019 notes; no individual model names confirmed, so versions name product lines only; country/founding left blank. Swing lure etc. kept as types (no named archetypes sourced). No bell or swivel brands confirmed beyond Asborno; creance, scale, cadge, bewits not added (accessories outside the planned list). Takagari equipment specifics not sourced, so the tradition entry stays general; forms left empty.
